ItemID: NA; Title: Clutch Tension Straps (3-Pack Mix: 16", 20" & 26"); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do plenty of workshop projects, but I do not currently have a specific use for tension straps.
ItemID: NA; Title: AUTOAlkins 8" Heavy Duty Suction Cup to Lift Large Glass, Tile, Marble, Industrial Vacuum Suction Lifter with Handle for Glass Lifting & Replacement, 240 lbs Load Capacity (2 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects involve fastening and fabrication; I have no large glass or tile job planned.
ItemID: NA; Title: NOPWOK EMF Meter Rechargeable Electromagnetic Field Radiation Detector Handheld Digital LCD EMF Reader Temperature Measure, Tester for Home Inspections, Outdoor and Ghost Hunting; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like practical inspection tools, but I have no particular electromagnetic field measurement need.
ItemID: NA; Title: FDGDFH Carbide Rotary Burrs Set, 20PC Double Cut 1/8" (3mm) Shank Compatible with Dremel Wood Carving Accessories for Woodworking Drilling Engraving Polishing Porting Trimming Metal Grinding; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These look useful for deburring drilled holes and trimming metal around the fasteners I frequently use, provided they fit my rotary tool.
ItemID: NA; Title: VIGRUE 672PCS Grade 8.8 M4 M5 M6 Metric Bolts Nuts Assortment, Heavy Duty Hex Head Metric Nuts and Bolts Assortment Kit, 13 Metric Sizes Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I repeatedly buy metric hardware, and these hex head bolts could complement my socket head and stainless assortments.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wintact Decibel Meter 30 to 130dBA, Digital Sound Noise Level Reader Tester Portable with Calibration for Classroom Home, School, Outdoor, Ambient; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Measuring workshop noise could be interesting, but it is not a measurement task I currently need to tackle.
ItemID: NA; Title: SALI 26pcs Grinding & Cutting Wheels 4 1/2 inch Set,Angle Grinder Wheel Set,20pcs Cut Off Wheels,3pcs Grinding Wheel,3pcs 4.5” Flap Discs, with 7/8" Arbor for Angle Grinder for Cutting Grinding; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Cutting and finishing metal fits my projects, but I would check grinder compatibility before choosing these because my recent wheels were 5 inch.
ItemID: NA; Title: ACEGMET P200 Thermal Camera, 90° Rotating Lens Thermal Imaging Camera with 2MP Visual Camera, 240 x 180 IR Resolution Infrared Camera, 20Hz, 3.5" Touch Screen Thermal Imager, -4°F~1022°F, IP54; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try thermal imaging to locate hot spots during home repairs; it extends the inspection work behind my borescope and infrared thermometer purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rubber Grommets Kit,Hincell 63Pcs Double Sided Round Rubber Grommet Kit for Wiring Drill Hole Firewall Hole Plugs Wire Protection for Automotive Plumbing, 6 Sizes 5/8" 13/16" 7/8" 1" 1-3/16" 1-1/2"; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Protecting wires passing through drilled panels fits my fabrication projects, and an assortment would be handy alongside my rivets and fasteners.
ItemID: NA; Title: MAYILON HT208D Digital Clamp Meter AC/DC 1000A 6000 Counts Multimeter Current Voltage Tester with Temperature, NCV, LPF, AC/DC Voltage and Current Test, Frequency, Resistance, Capacitance Etc.; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would use this for electrical troubleshooting during home repairs, especially checking voltage and current alongside my other diagnostic tools.
